At Nous, we believe open source is a practical tool as much as a philosophical ideal. It gives users the ability to build powerful, complex workflows chaining numerous local+cloud models, devices, and tools themselves instead of waiting for a company to enable them.

Four days ago $PEARL traded on two thin CEX books and sat 19% below ATH. Since then: Coinbase added it to the listing roadmap, spot printed a new ATH at $2.46, mcap went from $594M to ~$815M, and Entropy had to raise the io:PRL OI cap twice to keep up.

Longed it in the dip around 1.7 via @entropyIO. Up ~40% on price since, +120% on margin at 3x. But the price is the least interesting part.

Why the thesis got stronger?

- The whole bull case rests on one idea: GPU matmuls can secure a chain and serve inference at the same time, so the security budget stops being wasted hashes. That part was never the problem. The problem was distribution and demand.

- Coinbase roadmap (from the 19th of Oct, together with AXIS and STABLE) attacks the distribution half. PRL goes from exotic ticker on SafeTrade / BigONE / Ourbit to a name the biggest US venue has publicly committed to review.

- @prlnet cut inference prices ag

Gmgm frens!
Tough week, and an even tougher weekend in the market. Watching the portfolio bleed is never fun.
That said, a lot of interesting stuff happened this week. Was a bit busy so couldn't always relay my posts here, so here's a compilation of the key points, each with a quick TLDR.
1) Hyperliquid
- Entropy bull thesis: The #2 HIP-3 venue, pricing what has no price yet (Anthropic, OpenAI and co). The moat is the oracle. OI 3x in five weeks, still ~2% of HIP-3. Also joined their affiliate program.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2112508963795165515
- Entropy TLDR: tradexyz won round one with listed names, round two is private markets. Revenue masked by a 90% fee discount. Real test is the expected Anthropic listing around mid-Nov.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113598575380939265
- Pearl update: Coinbase roadmap, new ATH at $2.46, io:PRL OI 3x in four days. Still long from ~1.7. Still missing: proof of paid demand, and ~1M PRL issued daily.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2112996858671014239
- HIP-4 "flop"? Outcome volume went $11.5M (Aug) to $45.1M (first 23 days of Oct). Small vs Kalshi and Polymarket, but way cheaper and in the same account as your perps.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2114227282911154291
2) Private AI
- Arcium Blackthorn vs Venice: Venice ($1.3B) routes private AI through an Intel enclave that got broken twice in 12 months. Blackthorn cuts it out, at $49M mcap.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2112946400732570053
- Blackthorn follow-up: Only 600 to 4,500 confidential GPUs are rentable worldwide. Blackthorn makes it a software install for bare-metal fleets. Thesis unchanged.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113506713009786994
3) Robotics
- Axis TGE: Crowdsourced robot training data, credible product, sim-only results so far. ~$298M FDV on a 16.5% float, no value accrual to the token yet.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113331068208296241
- $CODEC: The most complete robotics stack in crypto at ~$6.6M mcap, with
machine.fun
revenue going to buybacks. My main bet in the vertical.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113555789189415123
4) Robinhood Chain
- Standard: Olympus-style mechanics with the failure modes designed out. 26.4M burned vs 18M issued five weeks in. Still banking.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113086951884722647
- Metric: Citadel pays Robinhood for retail flow. On RH Chain any LP can take that seat. Stock pool LPs finished 44% APR ahead of holding last week. I'm LPing.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2114045704696213697
5) Perps
- Bulk: The most serious perp DEX engineering on Solana, matching inside the validator set. OI ~10x in six weeks, still tiny. Real test is December.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113198220369375627
6) Papertrade
- Staker collapse: Payouts fell from $6.7M to $88K a day in under a week. ~84% of the $62M "revenue" was trader losses passed through to stakers, not fees.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113306300591526027
- Top 10 stakers: Lost $8.58M trading, already earned $9.06M back. The whales got paid before the door closed. The early losers became the house.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113375356526927916
7) Zcash
- $CYPH: Trackers show 0.78x NAV. Count the Winklevoss $0.001 warrants and you pay 1.68x for your ZEC. A miner with a treasury attached.
x.com/zerokn0wledge_/status/2113447079616110903
Stay safe out there and size accordingly.
Cheers, ZK!
